betterquesting:10.desc:8:
AE2's §6Decorative Blocks§f are building materials with no network function. They don't provide channels, power, or storage.

Available variants: §6Certus Quartz Block§f (4 Certus crystals), §6Pure Certus Quartz Block§f (4 Pure Certus crystals), §6Chiseled Certus Quartz§f, §6Certus Quartz Pillar§f, §6Fluix Block§f (4 Fluix crystals, emits light level 7 when powered), §6Sky Stone Block§f, §6Smooth Sky Stone§f, plus bricks, slabs, and stairs for each.

The §6Fluix Block§f is a great light source and looks fantastic in AE2-themed builds. Sky Stone variants come from meteorites and cannot be crafted.

§ePS:§f Check the §6misc/deconstruction_*.json§f recipes to break decorative blocks back into raw materials.
